defaults: Remaining parameters use #pragma parameter initial values, matching the RetroArch UI rather than divergent #else macros.
sampling: Linear sampling, including filter_linear2 from preset; the first two native-size passes inherit the default linear sampling policy.
targets: RGB8 at 480x320 for gamma and S-Video, RGB8 at canonical tube viewport size for CRT.
feedback: Preset feedback_pass=0 has no shader sampler consumer and requires no feedback target.
